title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E15 — Give Me Liberty ... Or Give Me Death
Michael enters a race for vehicles propelled by alternative fuels to flush out a saboteur who is putting the drivers' lives in jeopardy.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!

Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!

DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:

Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:

A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:

The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team fights robbers, led by a bandit (Jeannie Wilson), who ambush tour buses leaving a run-down Nevada casino.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E19 — Chopping Spree
The team investigates a used-car dealer (Dennis Franz) marketing stolen auto parts.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team rescues an heiress (Lori Lethin) from terrorists, only to have her insist on returning to save her terrorist lover.

title: The A-Team
description:

Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team abides by a cult's nonviolent philosophy to defeat corrupt townspeople who burned their community building.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team recalls incidents of Murdock's bravery and loyalty while he lies badly wounded by a bullet meant for Hannibal.

description:

Tawnia recruits the team to save her adventurer fiancé, captured by Amazon River pirates while searching for a lost city.
